GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Restrained & Settled Down 4 Lengths 3 Wide , made no ground to 4 Lengths 2-3 Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up and kept coming gradually in straight. (Winkers OFF FIRST TIME) # wide/battled on ok

Jumped Ok Restrained Took sit Settled Down 4th 1x1 and Outside winner To The Turn , clear run home Outside Just Kept Going One Pace had its chance in a slow time race, (t/t/1st w/1st) # same task as 1st
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mount did not appreciate track conditions, adding that this likely contributed to the gelding racing greenly in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back last Two Wide 10 Lengths 600m, did find some trouble at 200m when still at rear, passed a couple late but well beaten # well beaten
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Passing the 800m and 600m was checked after improving onto heels. Unable to improve between the 500m and 300m when held up on heels. Near the 150m was steadied for a number of strides when awkwardly placed on heels & lost rightful running. .

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then allowed to drift back and Settled Down 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths 3 Wide turning, steered 3 lanes off the outside rail Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: Unable to be tested final 150m when continually held up for clear running.] # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Raced three wide, with cover, in the early and middle stages.  Unable to be fully tested over the final 150m when continually held up for clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went back to 3rd last 5len 400m Hooked Out Straight ran home well # solid run from back
Jumped Ok , held rails inside Leader .5 Lengths 600m, slipped away soon after straightening and although wanted to get off track last 200m held a Clear margin and never in trouble # led all the way
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A pre-race veterinary examination of the gelding, which had not raced for a period in excess of 150 days, passed it fit to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to initial Lead 5-6 Wide as the field began to settle down, pressed on and led Two Wide by the 1100m, crossed at the 900m, Held Together in front but came back to lead a half head turning, Headed 200m and Lost Ground from there # worked hard early

Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1.5 Lengths Lead on fence settling down, Headed 1300m then Held Together middle stages, moved back up to trail 1 length Two Wide Under Pressure turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # no real excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Raced keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1/2 length Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn. weakened # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after jumping away was hampered when tightened between runners. Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages. Near the 1000m had to be steadied and shift wider after improving onto the heels of a runner.
